_comment: Seven BYOK panel headlines in story order, keyed by the language directory names used in artifacts/store-promos/<platform>/<profile>/<scheme>/<lang>/. The current English story supersedes the retired local-response panel in the vendored COWORK brief. Translations follow the register already used in docs/google-play-listing-translations.md and carry no price, discount, ranking or promotional claim (Google Play policy). Non-English strings still need native review before publishing.
